purpose: Resolve a teacher's selected Chinese grade into the strongest available curriculum/textbook evidence without inventing grade equivalence.
china_resolution_order: Check whether the requested concept has verified current PEP 12th-series evidence for the selected grade/semester.
If yes, use that exact current textbook placement and also show the national learning-stage requirement where useful.
If no, resolve the selected grade to its national learning stage and show the stage-level curriculum evidence.
Label exact textbook sequencing as 现行教材顺序待核实 when it is not directly verified.
Never substitute a legacy PEP sequence as the current sequence.

England: Resolve the concept independently against the National Curriculum in England progression.
Return the Year or Year range where the same concept is explicitly developed.
Do not choose England Year N merely because the user selected China Grade N.
If the concept spans several years, show the progression rather than selecting one arbitrary year.
US_Common_Core: Resolve the concept independently against Common Core grade progression.
Return the Grade or Grade range where the concept is explicitly developed.
Do not choose Common Core Grade N merely because the user selected China Grade N.
If there is no explicit Grade 1-6 Common Core requirement, say so rather than forcing a match.

output_rules: Always show the resolved China evidence level: exact textbook or national stage.
Always name the comparison jurisdiction/framework next to its year/grade label.
Do not generate an age-equivalence claim unless a separate verified age mapping is explicitly requested and available.
The comparison result may legitimately pair China Grade 4 with England Year 3 or Common Core Grade 3 when the concept progression supports it.
A difference in timing is descriptive; do not label earlier or later as better.
